note: Quest chain. Objective kinds: extract / loot / deliver / event. An event objective names the event id in `item` and is finished by living through that scene in data/events.json.

quests.title: First Blood
quests.text: You want work? Good. Go to Customs, walk out alive, and I will know you are not a liability.

quests.title: Field Kit
quests.text: My boys are bleeding faster than I can resupply them. Bring me bandages.

quests.title: Pharmacist
quests.text: Painkillers, the ordinary ones. Not for me.

quests.title: Checkpoint Seven
quests.text: A patrol on the north side is holding a dead checkpoint: three men, no radio, no officer for six days. Find out what they need and whether they are still worth supplying.

quests.title: Diesel
quests.text: Their generator is dry. Two cans of fuel buys them another week, and buys you their trust.

quests.title: The Radio
quests.text: Bring their set back to life: one rechargeable cell, second floor of the old station, third locker. What else is in that locker is your business.

quests.title: The Lieutenant
quests.text: Six days ago their officer walked south and did not come back. Find him, or find what he was carrying.

quests.title: Hold In Place
quests.text: The dispatch case is open and the paper inside has three numbers on it. Whatever you tell those men, tell it to their faces.
